Attached: 1 image

Prismor v1.77.0 is out. Highlights:

- spend budgets and allowed models per session, agent, user or device
- secret cloaking can now pull from Vault/OpenBao, Infisical or AWS Secrets Manager, with secrets bound to their hosts
- discover mcp shows how many copies of each MCP server your agents are actually running, with --prune to clean up
- a per-session context window panel, laid out like Claude Code's own
